node.title: Common-core shortening adapter and corrected KoalaBear walls
node.closure: typed reversible adapter + unaffected exact walls; false direction payment retracted
node.statement: The PR #1163 same-record common-core cancellation adapter is proved and reversible: (n,k,m)->(n-c,k-c,m-c) preserves finite slopes, maximal supports, same-support noncontainment, and m-k,n-k,n-m. The exact degree-interface, B_cell, and Jo-transfer walls remain valid. The former direction-separated J_13/J_14 payment is retracted after the affine-span counterexample; those two integers survive only as arithmetic for a false candidate formula. The support-local theta replacement is a separate proved node. No S/A/E or global ledger value moves.
